changes.comment: Support custom HTTP headers (e.g. an API key header) on map layers: `MapLayerSource` gains `savedHeaders`/`unsavedHeaders`/`collectHeaders()` and a `headers` prop, and the headers are applied during both source validation and tile requests for WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS and TileURL layers. Header-authenticated ArcGIS service metadata requests bypass the URL-keyed metadata cache in both directions so responses are not shared across differing authentication contexts.
